description: Checks whether numbers in an answer appear in the supplied evidence, allowing recognized rounding. The report preset can match derived values such as sums, using operands anywhere in the evidence. It cannot check whether the numbers are true, appear in the right sentence, or belong to the right table row. Numbers written as words are not read. Read the per-number statuses and skipped list even when the kit returns 'clean', since it can return that verdict with no numbers checked. With evidence 'North: 12 orders. South: 15 orders.', 'North: 12 orders.' traces, 'North: 13 orders.' is untraced, and 'Total: 27 orders.' is derived as a sum with the report preset.

options.description: Optional tracing settings. Omit to use the kit's strict preset.

checkIdentifiers.description: Report an unknown when a skipped identifier is absent from the evidence.

evidenceCurrency.description: Currency code for bare evidence values.

evidenceLocale.description: Locale for the evidence. Defaults to the answer locale.

evidenceOrder.description: Order of periods for directional derivations.

evidenceScale.description: Scale of bare evidence values. The kit does not infer it from a table heading.

evidenceScaleApplies.description: Set bare-and-currency to also scale currency cells without their own magnitude.

ignoreStructure.description: Skip list markers, bracket citations and similar labels.

locale.description: Locale for the answer. Default en-US.

maxCandidates.description: Limit the derivation search. Report preset default 50,000.

maxOperands.description: Number of operands to try for sums, differences and averages. Default 2.

preset.description: Default strict. Report enables derivations and looser unit matching.

roundSums.description: Allow sums and differences to match after rounding.

signMode.description: Use strict to flag dropped signs as unknown.

name: trace_numbers
title: Trace numbers in an answer to evidence
